description: This file defines the KineticEffect class, a kinetic scrolling effect implementation for the Kivy framework. It manages velocity, friction, movement updates, and stopping mechanisms for kinetic scrolling behavior.

classes.name: KineticEffect
classes.description: A class implementing kinetic scrolling effect, managing velocity, friction, movement updates, and stopping behavior within the Kivy framework.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KineticEffect instance, setting up history deque, trigger for velocity updates, and binding max_history changes.

methods.name: _resize_history
methods.description: Resizes the history deque when max_history property changes.

methods.name: apply_distance
methods.description: Applies a movement distance, updating velocity and value, and setting velocity to zero if below min_distance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a movement with a given value and optional timestamp, resetting velocity and clearing history.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the movement with a new value and timestamp, calculating distance from last position.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the movement, calculates velocity based on history, and triggers velocity update.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing movement, resets is_manual, and triggers velocity update.

methods.name: update_velocity
methods.description: Internal method to update velocity considering friction and time delta, and applies movement.

methods.name: halt
methods.description: Immediately stops movement without momentum, cancels velocity updates, and sets is_manual to False.
